module: Flowgraph node "Start Screen" (default category, once + singleActive): displays the start screen of a scenario (UI navigation 'scenario.start'). Inputs: flow, "reset", "layout" (portrait, htmlOnly, popup), "title", "text" (string or multiTranslationObject), "buttonText" (default 'ui.scenarios.start.start'), "portraitImg", "showProgress" (mission progress), "progressKey". Output: flow set to true when the player starts.
notes: Showing two of these at the same time will break everything (todo from the code).
_executionStarted is defined twice (the second definition replaces the first, without open/done).
Old format: _onDeserialized converts hardcodedPins.portraitMode into a portrait/htmlOnly layout.

_onDeserialized.desc: Converts the old portraitMode format into a layout.

buttonPushed.desc: Sets the button's output to true; the others to false.

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.

getCmd.desc: Returns the Lua command that calls buttonPushed(action) back.

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.
Name of the activated button or output pin.

onScenarioUIReady.desc: Hook: the UI is ready; sends the stored data back via 'ScenarioChange' if the screen is active.

state.desc: Screen fade state (1 = black reached, 3 = fade finished).

openDialogue.desc: Prepares the data and navigates to 'scenario.start'.

reset.desc: Resets done, open and _active to false.

started.desc: Closes the screen and sets the output flow to true.

work.desc: Handles reset; opens the screen when the input flow is active.
